properties.derivation_method: Proposed-public design envelope derived from the convex hull of mapped pedestrian/cycle/local-access linework inside the approved named host, clipped back to that host and with mapped water removed. properties.design_role: PUBLIC-D09 LM01 Compact Public-Side Visible Work Forecourt
properties.derivation_method: LM01 reduced first to the public-facing side of the Phase 20.6 band, then to the polygonal envelope of mapped pedestrian way W543824375 inside that side. This is a compact public forecourt, not a controlled building parcel or full-width functional strip.
